description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Kelger)] and [Ninja Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Kelger)
description.text: Ninja abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Ninja abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Ninja abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode II (Kelger)], removes [Dual Awoken Ninja Mode I (Kelger)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ninja Mode II (Kelger)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Ninja abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%, instant cast speed for Ninja abilities, casts Dual Lupine Shock after using Ninja abilities

description.name: Dual Lupine Shock
description.text: One single attack (4.45), ignores DEF, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
